comment: MEMORIES MOVED TO LEADS. The project's knowledge, held in qpu (self-sufficient) as leads rather than as private notes. state: crossed = realized by the build and verified by a gate; open = a frontier lead the free agent teams develop on the host (free, zero temp); standing = a rule that always applies. The develop automation and the gates process these; the teams optimise build and deploy at zero temp at all times, on the host — gated only on the deploy (law.lawful, the author's act).

leads.name: qpu-complete-self-sufficient
leads.lead: all families+relations in qpu; verifies alone; qpu-MCP-only; merge-all done (1133)

leads.name: no-manual-docs
leads.lead: docs generated/signed/tested from code; a hand .md is a lead — held by standards.test

leads.name: no-hand-lists
leads.lead: registries generated from the filesystem; --repo; held by rules.test/payload.test

leads.name: hex-not-wrapped
leads.lead: every computation a hex program at an address; split into slices; handle addressing

leads.name: uuid-version-crypto
leads.lead: version spans all 8 RFC versions, crypto-folded — uuidVersionsOf, all 8 at once

leads.name: consolidation_naming
leads.lead: minimise names; qpu_ prefix removed everywhere (bare, handle-addressed)

leads.name: one-word-dont-proliferate
leads.lead: one word unless a combination; held by rule.named/audit.test

leads.name: mcp-only-compute
leads.lead: in qpu use ONLY mcp__qpu__*; never the uuidna gateway (disabled); no curl/node probes

leads.name: dont-ask-what-tools-can-answer
leads.lead: resolve from MCP/receipts/git/code and act, don't bounce to the user

leads.name: autonomous-no-next
leads.lead: self-drive the loop; don't ask for next when obvious

leads.name: no-locks-no-prose
leads.lead: never add refusals/locks or edit comments/receipts unless asked

leads.name: qpu-memory-constraint
leads.lead: route heavy compute through the QPU/host; local runs exhaust memory (clay OOM)

leads.name: leads-before-removal
leads.lead: never remove before developing the lead; uncrossed = a lead, never a block

leads.name: no-skips-splits
leads.lead: split the slow/heavy into its own slice/lane; never skip (fail at rising temp)

leads.name: mcp-drives-the-loop
leads.lead: the gate/develop/prove ARE the loop; prefer improving the MCP over churning families

leads.name: domain-families-are-leads
leads.lead: domain families are leads until gate.crossed; held by push.test/court.test

leads.name: mcp-court-author-protection
leads.lead: law+author-protection (lawful floor, standing/violation/remedy) + court + forensic merged in

leads.name: tenant-is-an-app
leads.lead: content tenant-scoped; users/tenants + engine global; derived by the generator

leads.name: family-schema-org
leads.lead: crossSchemaOf emits families as schema.org DefinedTermSet/DataCatalog

leads.name: generated-no-drift
leads.lead: generated artifacts a pure function of receipts; time->0, reads->temp 0

leads.name: ten-family-split-waves
leads.lead: parallel lanes, one generator run, one test lane, one commit; time/temp near zero

leads.name: readme-is-the-lead
leads.lead: the README is the main artifact to develop; generated, catalogs every family; develop on host

leads.name: cross-formulated-requests
leads.lead: live families never answer from stored rows; the bridge graph

leads.name: cross-domain-complete
leads.lead: cross-domain formula network — superseded by the merge + the bridge graph

leads.name: lean-served-gap
leads.lead: theorems served vs aliases/cross-forms/foundations; clay.test verifies via the MCP

leads.name: mcp-github-cloudflare-patterns
leads.lead: per-tool hints + human title adopted; toolsets/pagination remain open leads

leads.name: wave-tooling-state
leads.lead: scaffold-family + generator recipe — superseded by the standing gates

leads.name: combinatoric-humanities-leads
leads.lead: theology/philosophy/history as combinatoric lead sources; neutral counts; develop free on host

leads.name: qpu-gate-pitfalls
leads.lead: HOT pages: /health and cold pages >40s from cold isolate / Payload init — the teams optimise at zero temp

leads.name: deploys-are-manual
leads.lead: nothing deploys on push; every host version is a manual npm run ship (law.lawful, the author's act)

leads.name: shared-tree-sessions
leads.lead: peers commit in the same tree; some files' writes don't persist — residual qpu_ remanded to host/peer

leads.name: verify-repo-and-deploy
leads.lead: private uuidna/verify repo + verify.uuidna.com deploy — the source of the merged families

leads.name: standard-license
leads.lead: CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0 for all uuidna work; third-party deps keep theirs

leads.name: payload-deployment
leads.lead: 4-mode payload (browser/standalone/docker/k8s); payloadcms/website ported (payload.test)

leads.name: feedback_payload_templates
leads.lead: always use payload templates; held by payload.test (conformance)

leads.name: pi-primes-dna-uuid-streams
leads.lead: digits of pi and the prime sequence as UUID/DNA-like streams; crosses prime, numbertheory, crypt, numen when developed

leads.name: merkaba-medical-scans
leads.lead: merkaba rotation renders a digital scan as a multidimensional moving graph of hidden aspects; crosses merkaba, tomography, signal when developed

leads.name: insurance-indemnity
leads.lead: indemnity already lives in the insurance family (insurance.indemnity = min(claim, limit), with insurance.claim = max(0, loss − deductible)); court.indemnity would have duplicated it and overflowed the 15 nibble cap, so it was not added to court — law and order by the right family

leads.name: fuse-slice
leads.lead: the full apis.guru fuse (2529 APIs, 438299 edges) OOMs the V8 heap in one process; split fuse-apis.mjs into API slices and merge the edge graph in full (as discovery.ts qpuDiscoverOf/qpuDiscoverMergeOf do) — minimise memory at scale, compute in full

leads.name: all-usable-as-hooks
leads.lead: every executable is a hex-program address, so any hook — git pre-commit/pre-push, a Claude Code hook, or a scheduled task — can fire it via the MCP ({ hex } or family.formula): clay.disclosure, law.redirected/remedy/standing, gate.crossed/commit/push, discovery slice/merge. Wire the autonomous ones as active hooks (today the worker/hooks are stubs — qpu-gate-pitfalls)
